name: Earthen Templar
label: Quest
description: Earthen Templar: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Twilight's Hammer and the elemental nobles they worship present a formidable threat to our operations in Silithus. With the new enemies we're facing inside Ahn'Qiraj, we cannot afford to lower our guard to our enemies outside.
Find a way to summon and destroy an Earthen Templar and report to Bor Wildmane.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Is your task done yet, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Good job, friend. Here's your next assignment.
